title: MUniverse Caillet et al 2023
description: High-density surface electromyography (HDsEMG) recordings from six healthy male subjects performing isometric contractions of the tibialis anterior muscle at 30% and 50% maximum voluntary contraction. The dataset comprises 256-channel electrode grids positioned on the muscle belly with synchronized force measurements, designed to investigate optimal electrode configurations for motor unit identification and representation.
methods_description: Participants performed trapezoidal isometric contractions at 30% and 50% MVC with linear ramps at 5% per second and plateaus of 20s and 15s respectively. Four 64-channel electrode grids (4-mm inter-electrode spacing) were positioned on the right tibialis anterior muscle. Force was recorded simultaneously using a load cell connected to a commercial dynamometer. Skin preparation included shaving, abrasion, and cleansing with 70% ethyl alcohol.
